metadata.scenario: An existing customer raises a billing dispute over services they did not receive, requesting an immediate investigation. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Lucille Davis. I'm calling about a billing issue I noticed on my recent statement. I'm sorry to hear that, Lucille. Can you please tell me what the issue is? Well, I was charged for two hours of personal care assistance last week, but I only received one hour. I understand your concern. Let me look into that for you right away. Can you please hold for just a moment while I check your account details? Sure, take your time. Thank you for your patience, Lucille. I see here that you were scheduled for two hours, but it looks like there was a mistake in the billing entry. I suspected as much. I just want to make sure this gets corrected. Absolutely, I can initiate a billing investigation for you right now. This should be resolved within a few business days. Thank you, that would be really helpful. I will also make a note to ensure you receive a refund for the extra charge. I appreciate that. Can you confirm how long this might take? Typically, the investigation takes about 3 to 5 business days. I’ll follow up with you to confirm once it's resolved. Okay, that sounds good. What about my next scheduled visit? Your next visit is scheduled for this Friday. Would you like to make any changes or adjustments to that? No, that should be fine. Great! Also, Lucille, I noticed you have some mobility issues. Would you be interested in adding some physical therapy sessions? I might be, but I need to check my budget first. I understand. Just remember, our physical therapy sessions focus on mobility improvement and are really beneficial. I’ll think about it. Thanks for the information. You’re welcome! So just to recap, I’ll start the billing investigation, and you’ll keep your appointment for Friday. Yes, that’s correct. Perfect! If you have any more questions, feel free to call us anytime. I will, thanks again, Margaret. You're welcome, Lucille! Have a great day! You too!
